columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.title: Fail-closed permission schemas must reject obsolete policy fields
columns.title_zh: 权限模式应失败关闭地拒绝过时策略字段
columns.source_zh: OpenAI Codex 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260817-001 with Skill 02 score 46/50. It exposes the strongest bounded Digital Employee governance question in today's pool: a caller-requested permission policy must not disappear silently when an obsolete field crosses an API boundary. Rejecting the removed field makes requested authority explicit and auditable instead of allowing a false belief that the policy took effect. Legacy project-root compatibility is also useful, but fail-closed rejection is the sharper responsibility and authorization boundary.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260817-001，Skill 02 评分 46/50。它提出了当天信号池中最明确的数字员工治理问题：调用方请求的权限策略在跨越 API 边界时，不能因为字段已经过时而被静默丢弃。拒绝已移除字段可以让请求的权限保持显式、可审计，避免调用方误以为策略已经生效。旧 project_roots 的兼容处理同样有价值，但失败关闭的拒绝机制更直接触及责任与授权边界。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the affected request/deserialization paths, exact rejection contract, compatibility behavior, tests, and whether any alternate path can still silently discard requested permission state. Keep the demonstrated schema-level fail-closed behavior separate from any broader claim of end-to-end authorization safety.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 仅核查受影响的请求与反序列化路径、精确拒绝契约、兼容行为、测试，以及是否仍存在其他路径会静默丢弃请求的权限状态；必须把已证明的模式层失败关闭行为与“端到端授权安全”这一更广泛主张分开。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.title: Execution environments need their own inherited shell-variable policy
columns.title_zh: 执行环境需要独立的继承 Shell 变量策略
columns.source_zh: OpenAI Codex 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260817-003 with Skill 02 score 45/50. The change gives each resolved execution environment its own shell-environment policy and applies that policy when filtering inherited variables while preserving explicit overrides. This creates a concrete architecture question about policy ownership at the environment boundary and how inheritance, isolation and explicit configuration compose. Independent timestamp-maxima recovery is a strong persistence-correctness fix, but the environment-scoped policy mechanism is broader and more directly architectural.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260817-003，Skill 02 评分 45/50。该变更让每个解析后的执行环境拥有自己的 Shell 环境策略，并在过滤继承变量时使用该策略，同时保留显式覆盖。这形成了具体的架构问题：执行环境边界上的策略由谁拥有，以及继承、隔离和显式配置如何组合。独立恢复时间戳最大值是很强的持久状态正确性修复，但环境级策略机制更具架构普遍性。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify EnvironmentConfig ownership, the exact variable inheritance/filter/override order, the turn-environment selection boundary, deny or secret-sensitive cases, persistence boundaries and tests. Do not infer complete process isolation from shell-variable filtering alone.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 仅核查 EnvironmentConfig 的所有权、变量继承/过滤/覆盖的精确顺序、Turn 选择执行环境的边界、拒绝或敏感变量场景、持久化边界以及测试；不得仅凭 Shell 变量过滤推断完整的进程隔离。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.title: Operational compaction must preserve the full audit transcript
columns.title_zh: 运维活动压缩必须保留完整审计记录
columns.source_zh: OpenAI Codex 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260817-005 with Skill 02 score 43/50. It exposes a concrete engineering tension between compact operational presentation and preservation of the full execution transcript. The grouping and flush rules are bounded, replayable and testable, making it a useful object for studying how an agent tool can reduce UI noise without discarding audit-relevant evidence. Route-aware doctor diagnostics are operationally valuable, but the transcript-preservation mechanism has the stronger reconstructability and observability boundary for this column today.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260817-005，Skill 02 评分 43/50。它暴露了一个具体工程张力：运维展示需要压缩，但完整执行 Transcript 仍必须保留。分组与刷新规则有明确边界、可重放、可测试，因此适合研究 Agent 工具如何降低界面噪声而不丢失审计相关证据。路由感知的 doctor 诊断同样具有运维价值，但今天该栏目中，Transcript 保留机制在可重建性与可观测性边界上更强。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify grouping identity, flush boundaries, maximum group size, the authoritative full-transcript storage path, replay semantics, failure and interaction boundaries, and regression tests. Do not equate compact display with a general guarantee of lossless audit retention beyond the demonstrated implementation.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 仅核查分组身份、刷新边界、最大分组大小、完整 Transcript 的权威存储路径、重放语义、失败与交互边界以及回归测试；不得把紧凑展示直接泛化为超出已证明实现范围的无损审计保留保证。
